features.title: Sheet boots and renders a loaded character with its tabs
Generate posts the form to the backend and renders the returned character
A weapon Attack button posts an attack card to the roll log
Every non-name buff column lines up across rows and sections
A picked spell files under its level for the book's class
Add menus list the whole applicable catalog A-Z before typing
Inventory picker adds many items across categories at once
Companions are full mini-sheets with derived math, buffs and conditions
Damage calculator: incoming damage through DR/ER/immunity
Inline @Save / @Damage / @Heal enrichers in feature and spell text
Pinned Quick Actions bar on Summary
Search + filter chips on every list tab
Wheel and relative (+5 / -7) input on HP, quantity, charges and buff level
Click an ability name to roll its check (1d20 + mod, check bonuses, negative levels)
Duplicate on every list row, inline split-stack, Shift x5 / Ctrl x10 steppers
Every list row posts its card to the roll log; one-click Defenses card
Settings picks the ability behind HP, saves, init, CMB, melee, ranged, AC and CMD; carry Str bonus and multiplier
Custom skills, per-skill ACP / trained-only flags and an edit lock
